description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.89.0 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Separate custom-tool grammar evidence from representation (#7282)
- Let a combo set its catalog row description (#7229) (#7284)
- Opt-in compression of outbound ChatGPT Responses request bodies (#7285)
- Auto-pause repeated permanent account refusals (#7153)
- Explicit single-model completion test (#7287)
- Opt-in OS desktop notification for low-quota protection (#7286)
- Opt-in advisory quota signals for JEV decisions (P1) (#6814)
- Add explicit enrolled Codex SSH peers (#6891)
- Default prompt-cache TTL to 1h on first-party Anthropic (#7341)
Bug Fixes
- Show the Gemini 4 Argon quota group separately (#7283)
- Honor project and location for API-key inference (#7266)
- Preserve matched and orphan Vertex Argon tool images (#7280)
- Never bake Claude first-party's own intercept proxy (#7327)
- Map provider input overflow to context_length_exceeded (#7352)
- Handle replayed hosted web-search history (#7250, #7269) (#7353)
- Keep tool loops on one target and make failover history safe (#7298) (#7354)
- Absorb community failover fixes (#7317, #7329, #7339, #7320) (#7355)
- Scope an inherited transpiler cache to the Bun version it starts (#7362)
- Scope server children's transpiler cache and keep scoping idempotent (#7364)
Chores
- Sign Windows binaries and MSI via SignPath (#7207) (#7356)
- Remove opencode-free and migrate saved configs (#7351)
- Register combo-tool-loop-pin in the core module inventory (#7357)
- Keep ACL subprocess work out of cache and registration assertions (#7358)
- Let the final-EPERM quarantine see through Windows 8.3 TEMP aliases (#7359)
- Await the fallback lease release on both passthrough relays (#7360)
- Compare the default containment result through the native resolver (#7361)
- Hold early client bytes in the socks5 egress fixture (#7363)
- Assert the scoped env and versioned bundled runtime in source oracles (#7365)
Other Changes
- Open dev at 2.89.0 before releasing 2.88.0 (#7263)
- Promote dev 52c326b479 to main as 2.89.0 (#7372)
